turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m here for a routine checkup, and I’ve noticed a lesion on my scalp. Otherwise I feel well—no fatigue, weight loss, or fever.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing a sudden and strong need to urinate, even when your bladder isn't full?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any sudden or strong need to urinate, and I’m not having urinary symptoms. I’ve only come in because of the lesion on my scalp.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any firm lumps or areas in your breast that feel different from the rest of your breast tissue?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any firm lumps or areas in my breast that feel different. I’m here only because of the lesion on my scalp, and I haven’t had any other new symptoms.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, firm bumps on your skin that are smooth to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed small, firm, smooth-to-the-touch bumps on my skin. I’m only aware of the lesion on my scalp, and I otherwise feel fine without any new symptoms.

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling in terms of body temperature lately? Have you noticed that you're having trouble cooling down or that your body feels unusually hot, even when you're in a cool environment?
turns.patient_answer: I’ve been feeling normal—no unusual heat or trouble cooling down, and no fevers that I’ve noticed. My body temperature feels steady in cool environments too.

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or anxiety in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: I’ve been feeling pretty steady lately, and I don’t think I’ve had significant stress or anxiety in my daily life. I’m just here because of the lesion on my scalp, and otherwise I feel well.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a sensation that makes you want to scratch your skin lately?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t had any itching or a sensation that makes me want to scratch the area on my scalp. The lesion is the main thing I’ve noticed, and I otherwise feel normal.

turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on my arms. I’ve only noticed the lesion on my scalp during this visit.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed it's been harder to find the right words when you're trying to say something lately?

turns.doctor_question: I'm here to help you, and I want to make sure I understand your condition accurately. Can you tell me if your muscles feel stiff or hard to move, even when you're trying to relax?
